1. **Shape.** Draft PR to `main`, `Fixes #32685`. 4 files, +402/−2 = 404 lines ≤ 3000; `check-governed-merges --pr 32748`: NOT governed. Changeset `.changeset/32685-record-form-over-drawer-after-reload.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`). Its sentences were checked against the diff: the form opens only once the route is shown and the drawer it names is drawn, a form already open is never closed by a later drawer, and a page with no drawer opens its form once the page is shown. `Clause-②: no` holds: `recordDrawerStack.tsx` is not reachable from the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry (`exports` has `.` → `dist/index` only, and `src/index.ts` does not re-export it), so the new hook, provider and constant are internal. The body was patched by the seat: r2 from the card thread, the seat-opinion line and the signed trailer.
2. **Premise, measured.** The card thread reproduced it on a real browser. After a reload, the drawer Sheet is the later z-50 body portal and covers 创建 (3 of 5 baseline runs), and `Esc` closes the drawer. After the fix, 6 of 6 runs show the form on top, 创建 clickable, and `Esc` closing the form first. Seat read of the diff: `useRecordFormOpensOverDrawers` holds the form shut one commit while drawers report from their layout effects, then opens while none is opening, and latches open. `RouteSlotShown` sits after the route element in the same Suspense boundary.
3. **Gates.** Synced with `main` first: K was 23 at `0ad90392`, so relay `pr_update_branch` was sent; the trial merge was clean. Check-runs on `0ad90392` before the sync: 55 = 40 success / 15 skipped, 0 failure. Check-runs on this head: 51 = 38 success / 13 skipped, 0 failure, `mergeable_state: clean`. Card thread: dispatch-gates 36/36 exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED; app-shell full vitest and type-check green.
4. **Accepted deviations.** (a) `recordDrawerStack.tsx` was edited. The claim allowed it "only if the stacking belongs to the drawer host", and the drawer is what knows it is still opening: one hook call in `RecordStackDrawer`, with the rest beside it. (b) The full app-shell suite ran on `8976d2ef`; later commits touch only the new test file and a comment, and the file is 5/5 on `0ad90392`. (c) Phone arm, asked by the seat and measured: on a phone `ObjectView.tsx` (~:1416) renders the page column, not `ObjectViewRecordOverlay`, so no drawer reports opening and the form is not held. It is pinned by a phone-width cell with its own ablation. In production `RecordStackDrawer` has one host, the desktop overlay, whose `navOverlay.open` sets `isOpen` in every mode, so no steady `current && !open` state exists. No contract review is owed: none of the four faces is touched (no `Clause-②: yes`, no narrowing, no published schema, no governed path).
5. **Out of scope.** Found while measuring the phone arm, this behaviour predates the PR: the phone redirect to the record page drops `form` / `formObject` / `formLink` (`objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` ~:225–253), so the form closes about half a second after it opens. Filed as #32750 (`domain:ui`, triage requested on #32588). `Skills-docs:` not owed.
